activeSlice.scope: Make read-only Hunter V1 shadow controls resilient to one transient rate-limit degradation by retrying only when every critical discovery/judgment failure is rate-limited, while accumulating total retry wall-clock latency, successful model cost, and search cost. All other degradation remains fail-closed.
successCriteria: A shadow V1 control with only rate-limited critical failures may be retried once after a bounded delay.
A control with any non-rate-limit discovery/judgment failure is not retried and remains fail-closed.
Retry wall-clock delay and all attempted control work are included in the returned latency/cost meters; no successful paid search or model cost is discarded.
The final control must still satisfy unchanged comparability requirements: non-zero evidence, measured model execution, no critical degradation and positive measured cost.
No rollout threshold changes: latency 1.5x, cost 1.5x, retrieval 0.85, failure 0.05, exploration 0.08-0.20, maximum topic share 0.34.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate passes on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Cohort screening exposed transient critical rate limits: persisted Python discovery github rate-limited after producing a real judgment, and ephemeral Vercel hunter-model exhausted provider retries with HTTP 429.
